summary: This is a code snippet definition for a text editor, specifically a template called a 'snippet' that helps writers quickly insert a formatted callout box into Quarto markdown files. When triggered, it will generate the boilerplate structure for a callout with a chosen type, title, and body text.

explanations.3: The 'prefix' is the short text you type in your editor to trigger this snippet — typing 'quarto-callout' will activate this template.
explanations.5: The ${1|note,tip,warning,caution,important|} syntax means the editor will show you a dropdown menu to pick one of those five callout types when you use this snippet.
explanations.6: The ${2:title} creates a second placeholder that says 'title' — after you pick the callout type, your cursor will jump here so you can replace it with your actual title.
explanations.7: The ${3:body} is the third placeholder where your cursor will jump next, letting you fill in the main content of the callout box.
